هذا المستند يبين خطوات 
 الصيانة الدورية 
 I1 ، 
 على نهايات الكابلات جهد 66 ك ف 
 التى تتم كل ثلاثة أشهر 
 M3 كما هو موضح أعلاه

تم إعداد المستند بواسطة المهندس/ عبد الرحمن حسن عبد الحليم واختبر فى 01 يوليو 
 2005 بمحطة محولات شمال القاهرة 220ك ف ووافق علية المدير العام المهندس/ عبد المقصود احمد محمود واعتمد من 
 المهندس/ أحمد شيلابى فيصل رئيس قطاع الجهد الفائق بمنطقة 
 كهرباء القاهرة

rows:
فتح امر شغل 
 وضرورة أن يحمل أفراد الصيانة كارت فئة السلامة والصحة المهنية

تسوير مكان العمل ووضع لافتات 
 التحذير
ارتداء مهمات السلامة والصحة المهنية

تأكد من فصل الدائرة من الجهتين مفاتيح وسكاكين ويتم التأكد من 
 ذلك بالعين المجردة
تأكد من فصل التيار المستمر الخاص بالدائرة

التأكد بمبين الجهد (البرج) أنه لا يوجد أي جهد على مهمات 
 الدائرة المفصولة
تأكد من توصيل سكينة الأرضي على رأس الكابل من الجهتين
ضرورة ارتداء الخوذة وأحذية الأمان

سلم ألومنيوم من 
 وصلتين كل وصلة 4 متر
عدة مناسبة (مفتاح بلدي ومشرشرة)

بلاور ،
 قطع قماش نظيفة

مبين جهد ، 
 أرضى محلى

نظف عوازل نهاية الكابل من 
 الأتربة أو أي متعلقات به

أفحص هذه العوازل 
 ولتأكد من أنها سليمة وليس بها أي خدوش أو شروخ

راجع أي رشح للزيت 
 من هذه العوازل

أفحص وراجع أرضي 
 الكابل والتأكد من سلامته وأنه مربوط بشبكة الأرضي العمومية للمحطة

راجع تربيط 
 الكلمبات الخاصة بالنزلات

نظف عوازل الاختراق 
 من الأتربة والتأكد من سلامتها من الشروخ أو الخدوش

تأكد من تربيط فلنشات 
 عوازل الاختراق

Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: Cable-001-r0a
Equipment: Cable terminations inside the bays, 66 kV, oil type
Issued to: Networks
Status: APPROVED
Approval date: 03 September 2005
Procedure: Periodic maintenance (I1-M3)
Next review date: September 2010

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps of the periodic maintenance, I1, on the 66 kV cable terminations, carried out every three months, M3, as shown above.

The document was prepared by Eng. Abdel Rahman Hassan Abdel Halim and tested on 01 July 2005 at the North Cairo 220 kV transformer station; approved by the General Manager, Eng. Abdel Maqsoud Ahmed Mahmoud, and endorsed by Eng. Ahmed Shelaby Faisal, Head of the Extra-High Voltage Sector in the Cairo Electricity Region.

rows: Open a work order, and maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card
Fence off the work area and place warning signs
Wear occupational safety and health equipment
Verify that the circuit is isolated from both sides, circuit breakers and disconnectors, and confirm this visually
Verify that the DC supply of the circuit is isolated
Verify with the voltage indicator (tower) that there is no voltage on the isolated circuit equipment
Verify that the earthing switch is connected to the cable head from both sides
Helmets and safety shoes must be worn
Aluminium ladder of two sections, each section 4 m
Suitable tools (open-end and ring spanners)
Blower, clean cloth pieces
Voltage indicator, local earth
Clean the cable termination insulators of dust or anything adhering to them
Inspect these insulators and verify that they are sound and free of scratches or cracks
Check for any oil leakage from these insulators
Inspect and check the cable earth and verify it is sound and connected to the station's main earthing network
Check the tightening of the clamps of the down-drops
Clean the bushing insulators of dust and verify they are free of cracks or scratches
Verify the tightening of the flanges of the bushing insulators

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Cables | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: Cable-001-r0a | Equipment: Cable terminations inside the bays, 66 kV, oil type
Issued to: Networks
Status: APPROVED
Approval date: 03 September 2005 | Procedure: Periodic maintenance (I1-M3)
Next review date: September 2010
Introduction
This document sets out the steps of the periodic maintenance, I1, on the 66 kV cable terminations, carried out every three months, M3, as shown above.
The document was prepared by Eng. Abdel Rahman Hassan Abdel Halim and tested on 01 July 2005 at the North Cairo 220 kV transformer station; approved by the General Manager, Eng. Abdel Maqsoud Ahmed Mahmoud, and endorsed by Eng. Ahmed Shelaby Faisal, Head of the Extra-High Voltage Sector in the Cairo Electricity Region.
Safety Precautions
Open a work order, and maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card | 
Fence off the work area and place warning signs | 
Wear occupational safety and health equipment | 
Verify that the circuit is isolated from both sides, circuit breakers and disconnectors, and confirm this visually | 
Verify that the DC supply of the circuit is isolated | 
Verify with the voltage indicator (tower) that there is no voltage on the isolated circuit equipment | 
Verify that the earthing switch is connected to the cable head from both sides | 
Helmets and safety shoes must be worn | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Aluminium ladder of two sections, each section 4 m | 
Suitable tools (open-end and ring spanners) | 
Blower, clean cloth pieces | 
Voltage indicator, local earth | 
Procedures to be Carried Out
Clean the cable termination insulators of dust or anything adhering to them | 1
Inspect these insulators and verify that they are sound and free of scratches or cracks | 2
Check for any oil leakage from these insulators | 3
Inspect and check the cable earth and verify it is sound and connected to the station's main earthing network | 4
Check the tightening of the clamps of the down-drops | 5
Clean the bushing insulators of dust and verify they are free of cracks or scratches | 6
Verify the tightening of the flanges of the bushing insulators | 7
